description: How indicator results are presented, in the report and the app (EPOCH-493). One file both read, so the two can't disagree. A set is marked stale when its newest indicator was more than stale_after_days old at the time of the check. The sentences were approved by the project owner (2026-10-15); no verdict word may appear in them.
limit: Indicators find only what is already known. No match does not show that a device is uncompromised.
nothing_checked: No match is reported because nothing was checked.
